blocks.text: Product DescriptionLiberating battery lifeTake on your day without worrying about recharging. With up to 10 hours and 15 minutes of battery life, you can work, watch more, and spend more of your time totally untethered.Intel UHD GraphicsSmoothly stream content and play your favorite games without the need for a dedicated graphics card. With excellent Intel UHD graphics performance, you'll see the difference in everything you do.Technical SpecificationsDisplay: 14" HD (1366 x 768), 250 nits, Touchscreen DisplayProcessor: Intel Processor N200 (up to 3.7 GHz burst frequency, 6 MB cache, 4 Cores)Graphics: Intel UHD GraphicsMemory: 4 GB LPDDR5-4800 MHz RAMStorage: 192GB Storage (128GB SSD + 64GB SD Card)Networking: Wi-Fi 6 and BluetoothOperating System: Chrome OSBattery: 2-cell, 47 Wh Li-ion polymer batteryCamera: HP Wide Vision 720p HD camera with integrated dual array digital microphonesKeyboard: US keyboardDimensions: 8.28 x 12.72 x 0.81 InchesWeight: 3.32 lbsI/O Ports2x USB Type-C 5Gbps signaling rate (USB Power Delivery, DisplayPort 1.4)USB Type-A 5Gbps signaling rateHeadphone/microphone combo

items: FLEXIBLE 2-IN-1 DESIGN – Designed for students and home users, the HP Chromebook x360 features a 360° hinge that easily adapts to laptop, tent, stand, or tablet mode—ideal for note-taking, online classes, reading, and streaming in different environments, with up to 10 hours of battery life

SMOOTH EVERYDAY PERFORMANCE – Powered by Intel N200 processor with 4GB LPDDR5 memory and 192GB storage (128GB SSD + 64GB SD) ensures smooth web browsing, document editing, video streaming, and light multitasking for daily tasks

HD TOUCHSCREEN DISPLAY – Tailored for online learning and entertainment, the 14” HD (1366 x 768) touchscreen with 250 nits brightness and edge-to-edge glass delivers clear visuals and responsive interaction for videos, reading, and basic creative activities

ESSENTIAL CONNECTIVITY – Ideal for home setups and school use, it includes dual USB-C, USB-A, a headphone/microphone combo, Wi-Fi 6, and Bluetooth for easy connection to peripherals and stable wireless performance during classes or streaming

CHROME OS SIMPLICITY – Perfect for students and families in cloud-based environments, Chrome OS offers fast boot times, built-in Google apps, automatic updates, and secure performance for Zoom meetings, web apps, and everyday online activities

DISCLOSURE - This brand-new laptop has been equipped with an IST SD Card. Includes a 1-year warranty on the IST SD Card from Issaquah Highlands Tech. 1-year HP warranty covering all other components. Auto Update Expiration (AUE) Date: Jun 2033
